catalogue.name: Palace

description: The Palace is the seat of power of your empire. As long as there is a Palace in the village, it cannot be conquered. At level 10, 15, and 20 you unlock an expansion slot, allowing you to train settlers or leaders. With settlers you can found new villages, and with leaders you can conquer other villages. A Palace also allows you to make this village your capital.
